name: VLKEB
description: VLKEB is a Large Vision-Language Model Knowledge Editing Benchmark designed to evaluate knowledge editing capabilities of LVLMs. It uses a multi-modal knowledge graph to bind image data with knowledge entities and extends existing metrics for comprehensive evaluation of editing reliability, locality, generality, and portability.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark from the LVLM knowledge-editing literature, cited mainly by researchers working on multimodal model editing rather than as a broad community standard.
notes: Improves on prior LVLM editing benchmarks with better data collection and extended metrics; dataset and code publicly available.
